entities.name: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abi Bakr was an Arab Muslim military commander and a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. He was the eldest son of the first Rashidun caliph, Abu Bakr, and a full brother of Aisha.
